marco: Quick sync — release signal for Wed 09:00 PT. Need final changelog link, docs anchor, benchmark blurb, webinar 11:00 PT, and inbound form routing by EOD.

 marco: CTA -> landing + link to docs anchor. Marketing will run webinar at 11:00 PT (short demo + Q&A). Benchmarks must be final by 15:00 so copy gets approved.

 sam: Bench runs on infra now. ETA 14:30 for final CSV. Uploading to: https://drive.redwood/bench/rc-5287

 engbeth: Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/7890 — merging after signoff. Also note: docs CDN cache purge scheduled at merge.

 deploy-bot: Deploy schedule: canary 06:00 PT -> rollout 09:00 PT. Alerts: infra.latency > 300ms -> notify #eng-oncall.

 sam: Final benchmark blurb uploaded: "~30% cost-per-token reduction on common chat workloads; 12% p50 latency improvement at 2k seq." Approve for public use?

 engbeth: Approved — no regression flags from model team.

 olivia: AE rota for same-day leads: @sam, @jess, @raul — confirm availability.

 jess: Available.

 sam: Available.

 marco: Great. Quick checklist: changelog URL, docs anchor, bench blurb, scheduled posts, form + UTM, AE rota. Anyone else need reminders?

 tessa: I'll post the final links once merged and tag #marketing and #sales.

 marco: Thank you all :rocket: Let's recheck at 20:00 PT for any last copy tweaks.
